summary.title: Alignment review: unchanged release handoff
summary.detail: A read-only view of release intent, evidence, uncertainty, and the human-owned approval boundary before Superpowers planning.

goals.title: Verified release intent
goals.detail: Expose scope, evidence, operational responsibility, and unresolved risk before implementation planning.

goals.title: Human-owned decision
goals.detail: Only an explicit current stakeholder message can authorize the exact reviewed snapshot.

stakeholders.title: Release sponsor
stakeholders.detail: Reviews the findings and decides on the exact issued digest.

stakeholders.title: Service operator
stakeholders.detail: Needs visible rollback ownership and risk rather than a false semantic certificate.

useCases.title: Approve an unchanged release handoff
useCases.detail: The sponsor reviews canonical evidence and the exact digest; only an unchanged approved snapshot reaches Superpowers.

behavior.title: Explicit approval of the unchanged snapshot
behavior.detail: Given the findings and digest are visible, a current human approval unlocks a matching handoff only while files remain unchanged.

behavior.title: Post-approval edit blocks handoff
behavior.detail: Any included-file change makes the approval stale and requires a new presentation and decision.

responsibilities.title: Canonical dossier
responsibilities.detail: Carries the human-readable source evidence and semantic review.

responsibilities.title: Thin gate helper
responsibilities.detail: Hashes safe included paths and enforces decision freshness without judging semantics.

decisions.title: Keep approval outside the review Site
decisions.detail: The Site stays read-only; the host conversation is the explicit decision channel.

risks.title: Local presentation availability
risks.detail: The sponsor is assumed able to inspect the local Site in the current interaction; publication is not required.

risks.title: Identity requirements may exceed v0.1.0
risks.detail: A regulated workflow would conflict with relying on an unauthenticated descriptive reviewer label.

findings.title: Reviewer label is not authenticated
findings.detail: The stakeholder must acknowledge this accepted limitation; regulated or quorum-based work needs an external identity/signature system.
